notablePrerequisites: Aura of Dominion attached to King Macar.
description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping King Macar, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling any opposing creature and creating a Gold token.
Activate the Gold by sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
